abstract: Simonetta Gribaldo did her undergraduate studies in Sicily, Italy and obtained her PhD in Rome in 2001. She then moved to Paris, France for her postdoctoral research. In 2005, she obtained a permanent position at Institut Pasteur, where she established her group at the Department of Microbiology. She is currently Full Professor and Head of the unit 'Evolutionary Biology of the Microbial Cell'. Her main research interests involve investigating key evolutionary transitions across the whole Tree of Life by merging in silico analyses with wet lab experimental approaches using newly developed models. Her recent work addresses key open questions concerning the evolution of bacterial and archaeal cell envelopes.
